pokedexEntries.su: It has strong regenerative capabilities. Even if parts of it are bitten off by fish Pokémon, it will return to normal within a few hours.

pokedexEntries.mo: Plankton, invisible to the naked eye, is its main food source. It comes onto the land periodically, but the reason for this is not known.

pokedexEntries.us: Long ago, it had a shell on its back. There’s now a vestigial plate on its back that’s hard but thin.

pokedexEntries.um: Their shape and color change, depending on their environment and diet. There are many of them at beaches where the waves are calm.

pokedexEntries.sw: Its search for food sometimes leads it onto land, where it leaves behind a sticky trail of slime as it passes through.

pokedexEntries.sh: The softness of its body helps disperse the force of impacts, so although its body is uncommonly squishy, it’s also surprisingly resilient.
